I stayed in Lang Co on the night of May 1st. Because I booked late, the owner recommended a villa instead of a homestay. However, I wouldn't recommend this place.

1. Upon arrival, when I asked the staff to carry my suitcase upstairs, they said their heels hurt so much they had to carry it themselves (and I had to ask them two or three times) ???

2. It was dirty and not clean; the toilet paper was flimsy. Luckily, I brought my own shower gel and toothbrush, otherwise, everything felt unusable...
3. There was no hairdryer :)

4. The motorbike rental price was 200,000 VND/bike/day. However, the bikes were very old and broke down while we were riding. Two girls broke their legs trying to pedal, and we had to ask a local for help to get them going again. When we called the owner, they told us to take the bikes to get repaired ?_?

5. My younger sibling's room was mistakenly entered by another guest at 5 AM :)
6. There was also no guidance, advice, recommendations, or sharing of destinations like at other places I've stayed at; it was like the staff and owner only cared about the guests...
In short, I was dissatisfied with the service, facilities, etc. Everyone should book early to get a good room!

Stayed one night at this homestay and were honestly very disappointed.

The rooms are essentially metal boxes—more like bunkers—with no windows, which makes them heat up a lot during the day. They’re also extremely poorly insulated; you can hear everything from neighboring rooms, even small movements like someone turning in bed.

The whole setup felt quite confusing and unorganized. We had to pay upfront, and some people handed us the key, but it wasn’t clear if they were actually responsible for the place. There was no proper welcome, no real communication, and no checkout process at all.

The property itself feels randomly put together: a tent in the back, constant watering in the front area, a huge table with no clear purpose, and some scattered plants. Overall, it lacks structure and feels a bit strange and unfinished.

On top of that, there was loud music playing throughout the night, which made it hard to rest.

While the room was reasonably clean, it definitely doesn’t justify the price—especially compared to other places in Vietnam. For what you get, it feels significantly overpriced.

Would not recommend staying here.

Do not stay here. You will regret it.
Descriptions on Booking do not match what you get when you arrive. The management will apologise for adding the wrong descriptions for rooms and then blame you for taking their word for truth and not checking the photos. "Garden view" - no such thing. The room has no windows. "Futon" now means a cheap foam mattress thrown directly on the floor. "Terrace" is a shallow step to put your shoes on. This business is riding on the back of one single good room and stretching the truth until it snaps. They have a total mismatch with their clientele and their idyllic surroundings. This was an extremely jarring experience. A relaxing rural retreat this was not!

We thought this place would be chill and that we would be able to spend the cooler morning hours on the grounds enjoying the views... But instead, we were kept up until 2am by a group of rude, rowdy, drunk guests. The management should have made sure that this did not happen. They did not. In fact, they lied and told us the loud music and accompanying human noise (screeching loudly to be heard on top of the awful music blasting out of the provided speaker) would be dealt with before 10pm. It went on until almost midnight, after which the human screeching and beer drinking continued uninterrupted until after 2am.

Not only was our night ruined but so too was our next day. After finally getting to sleep in our corrugated metal box room with no windows, we awoke (much later than planned) to find the same guests colonising the shared space yet again - although this time hung over, a lot quieter and commandeering all of the cooling electric fans. It was too hot to try to enjoy anything as it approached midday. We left quickly.

This was a terrible, terrible, terrible experience.

Avoid at all costs!

reviews.textTranslated:
I chose to stay at the resort with my family at a rather rushed time, and I didn't have much time to research it beforehand like I usually do when planning a trip.

However, upon arrival, I was extremely satisfied. Initially, I thought the place would be just average, but that afternoon, while cycling around (bicycles are available for guests at the resort – there are many, and the borrowing/returning process is very reasonable based on resort regulations. For example, my two-room villa had four bikes parked in front of the villa), I realized how vast the grounds are. The villa I booked was only located at the very beginning, near the main entrance and lobby area...
The accommodation area is further inside (with electric carts to take guests in and out)... and there are many other accommodation options inside, including rooms on the hill and hotel-style rooms (which are more affordable and offer more choices)... and they all share the same amenities as the common swimming pool and other shared facilities.

The weather wasn't ideal when we went, with dark clouds covering the sky... but towards evening, the sky cleared up 😅 which helped salvage the beautiful scenery. We were able to admire the clouds, the sunset (it would be even better on a clear day) over Tam Giang Lagoon.

The room service was good. The only problem my family encountered was that the air conditioner in our room was leaking water, requiring a technician to fix it, which interrupted our plans a bit. However, everything was understandable because the staff were very friendly and attentive.

I noticed that there weren't many staff members, but they were always quick to assist guests when needed.

In the evening, you can eat at the resort or walk to the restaurants in front where there are local specialties with a pretty good seafood menu.

Breakfast at the hotel was abundant and luxurious. The breakfast buffet didn't have too many dishes, but it satisfied all tastes and offered choices for my family, from children to the elderly.

My family really enjoyed this place and would definitely choose to return again soon.

Set along Canh Duong Beach on the sea, this upscale seaside resort is a 6-minute walk from the Thanh Toan Bridge and 9 km from the QL1A national route.
 Refined rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities; some have balconies and/or sea views. Suites add living rooms and dining areas. Room service is available.
 There are 5 restaurants and bars, including an open-air seafood eatery. Other amenities consist of a private beach area with sunloungers and games. There's also an 18-hole golf course, an outdoor pool and a gym, plus a spa and a kids’ club. Kayaking, jet skiing and snorkeling can be arranged.

reviews.textTranslated:
Does anyone think this is a picture of a villa?

- The floor is covered in dirt (insects defecated on it and weren't cleaned).

- The bedsheets and pillows in our room smelled strongly of men's body oil 😖. Nails on the bed came loose, causing two children to cut themselves and bleed 😢.

- Some rooms had TVs and refrigerators, others didn't. None of the rooms had bottled water; at least the accommodation should have provided bottled water for guests, not just empty bottles like this, especially since our group booked a 7-room villa for 6250k/night.

- Out of 7 rooms, 5 had broken door locks; if the outer doors weren't broken, then the toilet doors were all broken.

- The glass door of the shared toilet in the women's room was shattered, you could see everything from the outside :((.
- The kitchen was incredibly dirty, the walls were covered in black dust, not to mention the storage drawers and the counter...
A truly terrible experience regarding the room quality here. How can a service operate in such a poor state and still welcome guests??? The pictures online looked amazing, but upon arrival, I was horrified 😱. Everything looked excessively old and worn. The only positive point was the abundance of greenery and the airy atmosphere, but that was it. It was utterly awful!
reviews.text:
Có ai nghĩ đây là hình ảnh của 1 villa ko ?
- Sàn đầy chấm bẩn ( côn trùng ị xong ko chùi nên bị dính đầy )
- Ga gối ở phòng mình toàn mùi hôi dầu của đàn ông 😖, Đinh đóng ở giường bung ra làm 2 trẻ em bị quẹt chảy máu 😢.
- Tivi, tủ lạnh thì phòng có phòng ko. Nước suối thì ko phòng nào có cả, ít nhất chỗ nghĩ phải bỏ chai nước suối sẵn cho khách chứ ko fai trống trơn như này trong khi đoàn mình đặt villa 7 phòng 6250k/1 đêm.
- Đặt 7 phòng thì hết 5 phòng cửa khoá bị hư , ko hư cửa ngoài thì cửa toilet cũng bung hết.
- Cửa toilet chung phòng nữ bể kính toe, đứng ngoài thấy hết :((.
- Bếp quá bẩn , bụi đen cả tường chưa kể mấy hộc đựng đồ hay trên bàn bếp...
Một trải nghiệm cực kì tề về chất lượng phòng ở đây , sao mở dịch vụ mà có thể để nó tệ đến mức này vẫn đón khách được nhỉ ???

reviews.textTranslated:
The villa is situated by the river with expansive views, perfect for a family, friends, or group vacation. The riverside scenery along the Bo River offers a relaxing atmosphere, blending seamlessly with the breeze and water.

It features a beautiful outdoor swimming pool, a spacious garden, and an outdoor BBQ area – ideal for gatherings, small parties, or birthday celebrations.
Because the villa is located on the outskirts of Hue (Quang Dien), visiting major tourist attractions like the Imperial Citadel and Thien Mu Pagoda will take longer compared to hotels in the city center. Therefore, if you prefer exploring the city center, you should consider Soleil's properties there, which offer excellent service. However, if you prefer to reconnect with nature and the peacefulness of a Vietnamese countryside, then you've come to the right place.

hotelDescription:
Overlooking the sea and in view of the Đầm Cầu Hai lagoon, this polished beachfront resort is 9 km from the Chùa Diệu Ngộ, a Buddhist temple, and 51 km from Da Nang International Airport.
 Featuring warm decor and sea, lagoon, or beach views, the luxurious villas have soaking tubs, gardens, and wood sundecks, plus private pools. Upgraded villas, offering 2 or 3 bedrooms, add living rooms and additional bathrooms.
 Breakfast is free, and 5 elegant dining options include a Thai restaurant. There's a spa, a golf course, and a fitness center, plus a private beach. Sea activities like snorkeling and parasailing are offered.

So disappointed…

With my partner, we wanted to stay in a peaceful hotel for this period in Hue because it’s our anniversary. Then, we found this “incredible hotel” on the picture for a price of 890.000đ without the breakfast.

The staff is friendly, the room is great but you can hear everything outside (like there is no door). And there are two corridors with small stones for the ground so you can be sure to get up earlier and to sleep very late. Especially when there is a group of full Vietnamese people who do a party with karaoke in front of the hotel, who speak so loudly, who screams from the garden, etc. And yes, even with the earplugs, you can hear everything like they are next to you.

Va Riverside Retreat

We had a wonderful stay at Pilgrimage Village Boutique Resort & Spa! 🌿

What impressed us most was the exceptional hospitality. The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and always willing to help. They genuinely listened to our concerns, were quick to resolve any issues, and clearly put guest satisfaction first. This made us feel truly valued as guests.

The resort is beautifully maintained and very clean, with a stunning swimming pool and a peaceful, refreshing atmosphere surrounded by lush greenery. The buffet offered a wide variety of delicious options, and the complimentary morning yoga sessions were a thoughtful bonus for guests who wanted to start their day feeling relaxed and refreshed.

Overall, Pilgrimage Village is a wonderful place to unwind and escape the busy world. The beautiful surroundings, excellent facilities, and especially the outstanding customer service made our stay memorable.

Highly recommended! Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so special. We would love to return!
Luxury, relaxation and very friendly staff. Outstanding food!
It’s an absolute paradise. Lush and green, beautiful suites and the staff are amazing.

My wife, daughter and I spent two wonderful nights at Pilgrimage Village Resort, and it was undoubtedly one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

After the busy streets of Hanoi and Da Nang, and before heading to the lively chaos of Saigon, this place was exactly what we needed. A true oasis of peace and relaxation.

The resort is simply stunning. The lush gardens, beautiful flowers, swimming pools and every little corner of the outdoor areas create an incredible atmosphere of calm and beauty. Just walking around the property is a pleasure.

Our villa was exceptional. Spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, spacious and extremely comfortable. Even the smallest details had been considered, including mosquito treatment in the room to ensure a peaceful night's sleep. And the bathroom? Absolutely enormous! Beautifully designed, incredibly well equipped and finished with exceptional taste and attention to detail.

Breakfast was another highlight. An amazing selection of fresh, high-quality food, with pretty much everything you could wish for.

The staff deserve special recognition. Everyone was incredibly friendly, attentive and professional, always available when needed but never intrusive. That perfect balance of hospitality that makes you feel truly welcome.

And I cannot finish this review without mentioning two experiences that made our stay even more special.

First, the massages! We received 30 minutes of complimentary massage for each night of our stay, meaning a full hour per person over our two nights. The lady who treated me was absolutely fantastic. Without exaggeration, one of the best massages I have ever had!

Second, the 7 AM beginner's Tai Chi session. What a wonderful way to start the day! Practising Tai Chi surrounded by such beautiful and peaceful surroundings was an experience I genuinely believe everyone should try at least once.

Pilgrimage Village is much more than just a hotel. It is a place where you can slow down, disconnect from the outside world and simply enjoy being there.

Would I return? Without the slightest hesitation. And next time, I would definitely stay longer!

Thank you to the entire team for making our family stay so memorable.

Ancient Hue Garden Houses – A Hue experience even more beautiful than expected! 🌿

I was truly surprised by how much more beautiful and luxurious Ancient Hue was than I had anticipated! Before arriving, I thought it would just be a traditional garden-style hotel, but once inside, I realized how meticulously and exquisitely it's been designed.

Nestled in the Kim Long area, Ancient Hue embodies the beauty of old Hue houses, with its ancient tiled roofs, intricate wood carvings, courtyards, and lush green gardens. Traditional architecture is cleverly combined with modern amenities, creating a space that is both classic and luxurious without being ostentatious.

What I liked most was the sense of privacy and tranquility. Everything is gentle and elegant, from the decor and colors to the harmony between architecture and nature. The sophistication of Ancient Hue doesn't lie in its flashiness but in its profound aesthetic sense, making you feel like you're in an old Hue mansion rather than a typical hotel.

This time, I arrived in Hue during the rainy season. The sky was overcast, the trees were a deep green, and the rain-soaked tiled roofs added to the tranquil and romantic atmosphere. There was no need to go far; just sitting and admiring the garden, listening to the rain, was enough to make the trip worthwhile.

Ancient Hue is not only beautiful but also soulful. It's a place to stay that truly embodies Hue's unique character, luxurious in its own way, and far exceeded my expectations. 💚
reviews.text:
Ancient Hue Garden Houses – Một góc Huế đẹp hơn cả mong đợi! 🌿

Thật sự bất ngờ vì Ancient Hue đẹp và sang hơn kỳ vọng của mình rất nhiều! Trước khi đến chỉ nghĩ đây là một khách sạn mang phong cách nhà vườn truyền thống, nhưng bước vào rồi mới thấy nơi này được chăm chút và tinh tế đến từng chi tiết.

Nằm nép mình trong khu Kim Long, Ancient Hue mang vẻ đẹp của những ngôi nhà rường Huế xưa, với mái ngói cổ, những đường nét chạm khắc gỗ, khoảng sân và khu vườn xanh mướt. Kiến trúc truyền thống được kết hợp khéo léo với tiện nghi hiện đại, tạo nên một không gian vừa cổ kính, vừa sang trọng nhưng không hề phô trương.

Điều mình thích nhất là cảm giác riêng tư và bình yên ở đây. Mọi thứ đều nhẹ nhàng, thanh lịch, từ cách bài trí, màu sắc đến sự hài hòa giữa kiến trúc và thiên nhiên. Cái sang của Ancient Hue không nằm ở sự hào nhoáng mà ở gu thẩm mỹ rất có chiều sâu, khiến người ta có cảm giác đang ở trong một dinh thự Huế xưa hơn là một khách sạn thông thường.

Lần này lại đến Huế đúng những ngày mưa. Trời âm u, cây cối xanh thẫm, những mái ngói ướt mưa càng làm không gian thêm trầm mặc và lãng mạn. Chẳng cần đi đâu xa, chỉ ngồi ngắm khu vườn, nghe tiếng mưa rơi cũng đủ thấy chuyến đi thật đáng giá.

Ancient Hue không chỉ đẹp mà còn có hồn. Một nơi lưu trú mang đậm bản sắc Huế, sang trọng theo cách rất riêng và thực sự vượt xa mong đợi của mình. 💚

Quite easily the best hotel I've ever stayed in. Service was impeccable, with friendly and warm staff diligently attending to our every need. The architecture, grounds and rooms are beautiful - especially the restaurant and the bar area.

We opted for a room with a private pool, and were pleasantly surprised that it was cleaned twice daily including mopping the floors, which was a nice touch. The pool was incredibly clean and a delight to use, secreted away under giant plants which made for a lovely ambience.

Given our love of Vietnamese food, we were surprised to find that the restaurant here provided some of the best, authentic meals we've eaten in the country. Breakfast was included, a la carte and unlimited, and the quality was miles above that of standard breakfast buffets elsewhere. We usually ordered three dishes between us to share, as well as iced coffees and infused teas or fresh juices, and staff would routinely ask if we wanted more.

Both breakfast and dinner had a wide selection available, and we felt this did not come at the cost of quality. We tried noodle soups, duck confit, chilli grouper, clams, shrimp in Thai sauce, fried rice, banh mi, bun bo hue... I even had a cheeseburger for breakfast out of curiosity, and it was so good I had to order a second one!

It also has to be said that the opening times of the restaurant are much appreciated - breakfast served until 10:00, and dinner until 22:00, allows for so much flexibility when it comes to going out on day tours, or wanting a lie-in.

Finally, the hotel were very helpful in organising a transfer to our next hotel in Hoi An. They had an itinerary planned, and the price was competitive with similar excursions on Booking.com. This gave us lovely peace of mind!

The only downside would be that the location of the hotel is not within easy walking distance of many of the attractions or eateries of Hue, but with ease of travel through apps like Grab this is a very minor issue.

We already wanted to come back to Vietnam after this holiday, and this accomodation has made that even more likely. I would recommend that anyone coming here stays at Ancient Hue Garden Houses!

description: Refined quarters in a premium riverfront hotel featuring fine dining, a spa & an outdoor pool.
address: 5 Lê Lợi, Street, Thuận Hóa, Huế 530000, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Set on a lush 3-hectare estate along the Perfume River, this premium hotel with art deco styling is 2 km from the Imperial City and 16 km from Phu Bai International Airport.
 Accommodations range from relaxed rooms overlooking the pool to elegant suites with 4-poster beds, separate living areas and claw-foot tubs. All have flat-screen TVs, tea and coffeemakers, and free Wi-Fi; most offer balconies with river or garden views.
 Along with a fine-dining restaurant and a lobby lounge, there’s a saltwater outdoor pool, a poolside bar, a spa and a gym. Other amenities include dinner cruises, cooking classes and a boutique selling local handicrafts.

reviews.textTranslated:
-Rooms: Beautiful, clean, comfortable, with plenty of water/tea/soft drinks and seasonal fruit. Previously, the area right next to the Perfume River had a river view and a small path from the garden to the riverbank, but now that area is built, there's no longer a path to the river from the garden, and the view is somewhat limited.

-Staff: All the staff are very lovely, from the receptionist, the staff at Le Parfum restaurant, the doorman, the bartender… they are all friendly and enthusiastic.

-Location: Right in the city center, easy to get around, the hotel has bicycles if you want to cycle around Hue.

-Swimming pool: Quite good.

-Atmosphere: Quiet, even though the hotel is on a main road, the rooms are quiet and you sleep very well.

-Food: Delicious! The French bread and braised pork were the two best dishes I tried during this stay. Azerai has a small vegetable garden to supply the restaurant. You should definitely try the salted coffee at Le Parfum restaurant; it's delicious.

- Bar: quiet, chill, the bartender is charming, and the drinks are quite good.

reviews.textTranslated:
I booked a cheap room, so I didn't expect a fantastic hotel; I was only staying one night, so I didn't need much. However, upon check-in, the room didn't have blankets, and it took two hours for the receptionist to provide them. The room was peeling paint, the air conditioner was too hot, and there were flies.

I was especially unhappy with the receptionist who wore braces; she was very rude. As soon as I arrived, she told me I had to check out at 11:30 AM, even though the app I booked indicated a 12:00 AM check-out. I've always stayed at hotels with check-in times of 2 PM and check-out times of 12 AM. I said, "I see you don't have to check out until 12 AM," and she replied, "No, please check out at 11:30 AM." I didn't say anything more because my work was finished around 10 AM the next morning. But I started to think the service was terrible. The next day, because my work lasted longer, I arrived back at the hotel at 11:15 AM to get my key and waited for her for 5.7 minutes because she was busy entertaining foreign guests. Then I asked the staff if I could check out at 12 PM via the app because my child was sweating. I wanted to let the child rest a bit and take a shower in the bathroom to clean up, and I would check out at 12 PM. The staff rudely refused, even though I asked to let the child shower for a little while. I then reported back that the app showed my check-out at 12 PM. The staff member said they had already notified me yesterday at 11:30 AM. But I paid for check-out until 12 PM! Yesterday I didn't argue because I thought I'd finish my business early. I paid in full; I didn't ask for anything. After that, I checked out at 11:28 AM. I went straight to the room to get my things because I had already packed beforehand. I told the staff I would give a one-star rating, and they apologized and asked for my understanding. This is the second time. They apologize and ask for understanding just because I'm giving a one-star rating. A very bad experience at this hotel.
